data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, covering: default value loaded when key absent; values 0, 1, 3 honored as-is; value 10 clamped to 3 with warning log assertion

## Test Approach
Write 5 new test functions in tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py targeting
_read_config_int and _clamp_schema_correction_attempts functions (which do not yet exist
in runner.py). These tests MUST fail (RED) before Task B is implemented.

Add RED markers to .test-index for each test function before committing.

### Test function specifications (Given/When/Then):

**test_read_config_int_returns_default_when_key_absent**
- Given: a dso-config.conf with no review.schema_correction_max_attempts entry
- When: _read_config_int("review.schema_correction_max_attempts", 1, config_path) is called
- Then: returns 1 (the default)

**test_read_config_int_returns_value_when_key_present**
- Given: dso-config.conf contains "review.schema_correction_max_attempts=2"
- When: _read_config_int("review.schema_correction_max_attempts", 1, config_path) is called
- Then: returns 2

**test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_honors_zero**
- Given: max_attempts=0
- When: _clamp_schema_correction_attempts(0) is called
- Then: returns 0 (disable-correction sentinel honored as-is)

**test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_honors_within_ceiling**
- Given: values 1 and 3
- When: _clamp_schema_correction_attempts(v) is called for each
- Then: returns the value unchanged (no clamping, no warning)

**test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_clamps_above_ceiling_with_warning**
- Given: max_attempts=10, stderr captured via capsys or io.StringIO redirect
- When: _clamp_schema_correction_attempts(10) is called
- Then: returns 3; a warning line is emitted to stderr containing "schema_correction_max_attempts" and "clamped" (or equivalent)

## Implementation Notes
- Import pattern: follow existing tests — `import dso_ci_review.runner as runner_mod` inside the test body
- Use `tmp_path` fixture for config file creation (consistent with existing test_build_agents_for_tier_reads_*_model_from_config pattern)
- Use `capsys` for warning emission assertion (for _clamp call, warning goes to sys.stderr)
- Tests will fail with AttributeError before Task B is implemented — this is the correct RED state

## RED Marker (.test-index)
Add these entries to .test-index (append to existing runner.py line):
  [test_read_config_int_returns_default_when_key_absent]
  [test_read_config_int_returns_value_when_key_present]
  [test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_honors_zero]
  [test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_honors_within_ceiling]
  [test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_clamps_above_ceiling_with_warning]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) -- NOTE: these 5 new tests are expected to fail (RED) before Task B; all OTHER tests in the file must still pass
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py -k "not (test_read_config_int or test_clamp_schema_correction)" --tb=short -q 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -v "failed\|error"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py
- [ ] 5 new test functions are present in test_runner_smoke.py
  Verify: grep -c "def test_read_config_int\|def test_clamp_schema_correction" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py | awk '{exit ($1 < 5)}'
- [ ] RED marker entries added to .test-index for all 5 test functions
  Verify: grep '\[test_read_config_int_returns_default_when_key_absent\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index && grep '\[test_clamp_schema_correction_attempts_clamps_above_ceiling_with_warning\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] All 5 new tests fail (RED) when run in isolation before Task B is implemented
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py::test_read_config_int_returns_default_when_key_absent 2>&1; test $? -ne 0
- [ ] Test is behavioral: each test calls a function and asserts on the return value or stderr output — not a grep scan of runner.py source
  Verify: manual review — test approach describes function invocation and output assertion

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Write RED tests for _read_config_int and _clamp_schema_correction_attempts in test_runner_smoke.py
